summary: Learn to manage facilities assets, work orders and service performance with practical exercises. View the five-day course outline.
lede: Facilities management coordinates people, places and processes to support building services, asset care and service requests. This foundation course is for facilities coordinators, building operations supervisors, maintenance planners and asset officers who organize routine work and explain backlogs. Participants practise structuring asset registers, prioritizing maintenance requests, planning preventive schedules and tracking service and contractor performance with work-order and KPI templates; ISO 41001:2018 and ISO 55001:2024 are introduced as practical reference points, not as deep implementation programs.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for people who coordinate building operations, maintenance demand or outsourced facility services and need practical controls for everyday work.
modules: Facilities KPI Reporting and Action Planning
prerequisites: Designed for foundation-level learners with basic familiarity with workplace services, building operations or maintenance coordination. No coding is required. Practical exercises use facilities case data and templates; Excel is used for basic KPI summaries.
